title: Image Processor & Day/Night Classifier
description:
Implemented image transformation pipeline (grayscale, inversion, edge highlighting) using vectorized NumPy operations.
Built K-Nearest Neighbors classifier from scratch to distinguish day vs. Night images using pixel-intesity feature space.
Extracted numerical feature vectors from image matrices to enable distance-based calculation.
Added audio-processor that allows an audio clip to be sped up, reversed, or reverb

title: Goodreads User Preference Analysis
description:
Scraped and parsed 300+ book records from 2017-2022 to construct dataset of ratings, genres, descriptions, and tags.
Cleaned and normalized scraped HTML data into a structured tabular format for downstream modeling.
Engineered structured features to compare pre- vs post-COVID reading trends using statistical analysis.

title: Food.com Recipe Tags Analysis
description:
Developed predictive regression model to estimate user engagement based on recipe metadata and tags.
Designed preprocessing workflow including feature encoding, normalization, and missing-data handling.
Performed exploratory data analysis to identify high-impact predictors prior to model training.
Evaluated model performance using cross-validation and error analysis on website.

title: Taylor Swift Song Recommender Tool
description:
Uses data from Spotify to create a song recommender, and modifies it using the pandas module.
User inputs a Taylor Swift song and a song from the Billions Club that is the most similar is returned.
Checks similarity by comparing features such as danceability, energy, and more by using Euclidean Distance.
Also utilizes TF-IDF (term frequency-inverse document frequency) to determine the single word that best represents the input Taylor Swift song.

title: Friends Reboot Logistics Tool
description:
Grabs data of the original Friends T.V show using the pandas module.
Created linear regression models to compare correlation between different features such as imdb rating and viewership.
Used episode IMDB ratings to determine the best reboot director.
Generated potential reboot episode titles using original episode titles, and discovered the probability of an reboot episode title being the same as an original episode title

title: SoCal City GeoGuesser
description:
Trained a Convolutional Neural Network to classify images into Southern California cities (San Luis Obispo, Riverside, Anaheim, San Diego, Los Angeles, Bakersfield).
Achieved 92% test accuracy through data preprocessing, augmentation, and hyperparameter tuning.
Implemented in Python using TensorFlow/PyTorch.
